canonical_data: a paper directory with a Tantivy full-text index, chunk embeddings, and a searchable archive of prior answers under PQA_HOME
strengths: The evidence pipeline ranks chunks, has an LLM summarize each in context, re-scores, and answers with in-text citations, so claims trace to source passages
The Tantivy index, embeddings, and prior answers persist under PQA_HOME, so a queried directory skips indexing and chunking on later runs
Three invocation modes cover the automation spectrum: the default ToolSelector agent, a fixed-path fake agent, and a manual Docs path the README documents as performance-neutral
Provider surface is broad behind one settings object: LiteLLM models, Ollama and llamafile servers, and local sentence-transformer embeddings
weaknesses: Defaults send document text to OpenAI models and metadata to four web APIs, and the README warns that 7B-class local models perform poorly
CalVer releases carry no backwards-compatibility guarantees, and stored index pickles already broke between major versions
The opt-in pymupdf reader extra is AGPL-3.0, and the zotero extra pulls it in as well, which complicates redistribution of those configurations
The hosted Edison Scientific and FutureHouse literature agents are separate products outside this record, which covers only the self-hosted library and CLI
why_it_matters: High-accuracy cited question-answering over the scientific literature with a persistent local corpus index and an agentic evidence loop.
